title: Flood_Susceptibility_Modeling
summary: A flood susceptibility and risk assessment pipeline using multi-class classification, data augmentation, and explainable AI to address class imbalance in flood risk mapping. Its sampling-method comparison notebooks import the standalone CTGAN package to synthesize minority-class flood samples for balancing training data.
needs: Confirm whether CTGANSynthesizer references elsewhere in notebooks use SDV's wrapper or only the standalone ctgan package.
